## About

I am a computational biologist and Lead Bioinformatician at the University Medical Center of Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz, Germany. My research focuses on machine learning for genomics, with particular interests in DNA language models, data quality in multi-omics, and the biosecurity implications of generative AI in the life sciences. I am a father of two.

I maintain active international collaborations, including work with [DeoxyTech Ltd.](https://deoxytech.com/) (Manchester, UK) on DNA embedding models, involvement in the [OpenBioML](https://www.openbioml.org/) open science community, and partnerships with researchers across Europe on biosecurity and AI safety in biology.
